title: Tube under internal pressure
sentence: A pipe wall meshed as a revolved section and loaded with internal pressure — the sweep mesher's revolve in one model.

expected.reference: thin wall: σ_θ ≈ pr/t = 8 × 47.5/5 = 76 MPa away from the base

theory: For a thin wall the hoop stress is $\sigma_\theta \approx \dfrac{p r}{t}$; the peak here is higher because the welded base restrains the hoop expansion, which is a local bending boundary layer of length $\approx 2.5\sqrt{rt}$ and not a wall-thickness problem.
